idea.title: ModelRouter — Smart switcher between local and cloud LLMs

plan.tagline: Seamlessly switch between local and cloud LLMs from one CLI
plan.problem: Developers waste time manually switching between local LLMs (for privacy/offline) and cloud LLMs (for power/accuracy), with no unified workflow
plan.solution: CLI tool that routes prompts to the best LLM based on cost, latency, privacy needs, and model availability. Caches responses locally for offline use and syncs with cloud when online. Includes a demo mode with hardcoded models for instant testing.
plan.target_market: Solo developers and small teams building AI-powered apps who need flexibility between local/offline and cloud LLMs without rewriting code
mvp_features: Switch between local/cloud LLMs via CLI flags or config file
Auto-detects online/offline state and routes accordingly
--demo mode with hardcoded models for offline testing
Simple SQLite cache for response history and cost tracking
Basic reporting of usage stats and model performance

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for model configs and response cache, plus add/list commands to manage models

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: generate usage reports and basic alerts for model limits/costs

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: implement --demo mode with hardcoded models, improve --help, handle edge cases like invalid API keys

plan.demo_script: Run `modelrouter --demo` to see a simulated conversation with 3 hardcoded models (tiny, medium, cloud). Shows routing logic, response caching, and offline/online switching without any setup.
plan.phuket_angle: Phuket-based travel agencies or tour operators could use ModelRouter to run lightweight local LLMs on-site for customer queries while syncing with cloud models for complex requests, reducing cloud costs during peak tourist seasons.
